name: belanja
description: Belanja - personal monthly expense management app. Test runner entry point (tests live under app/tests/).

scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run check && node --check tests/api/*.mjs && node --check tests/browser/*.cjs
scripts.test:api: node tests/api/test-crud-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-monthly-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-monthly-rules-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-time-rules.cjs && node tests/api/test-dashboard-history-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-month-ownership-8080.mjs && node tests/api/test-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:main && npm run test:browser:installments && npm run test:browser:series && npm run test:browser:monthly-ui && npm run test:browser:close-confirm && npm run test:browser:mobile-pwa
scripts.test:browser:main: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-pw.cjs"
scripts.test:browser:installments: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-dashboard-installments.cjs"
scripts.test:browser:series: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-dashboard-series.cjs"
scripts.test:browser:monthly-ui: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-monthly-ui.cjs"
scripts.test:browser:close-confirm: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-monthly-close-confirm.cjs"
scripts.test:browser:mobile-pwa: docker run --rm --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e BASE_URL='http://host.docker.internal:8080' -v "$PWD/tests/browser:/app" -w /app mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.45.0-noble sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; test -d node_modules/playwright || npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node test-mobile-pwa.cjs"
scripts.test:browser:local: node tests/browser/test-pw.cjs && node tests/browser/test-dashboard-installments.cjs && node tests/browser/test-dashboard-series.cjs && node tests/browser/test-monthly-ui.cjs && node tests/browser/test-monthly-close-confirm.cjs && node tests/browser/test-mobile-pwa.cjs
scripts.check:tests: node --check tests/api/test-crud-8080.mjs && node --check tests/api/test-monthly-8080.mjs && node --check tests/api/test-monthly-rules-8080.mjs && node --check tests/api/test-time-rules.cjs && node --check tests/api/test-dashboard-history-8080.mjs && node --check tests/api/test-month-ownership-8080.mjs && node --check tests/api/test-e2e.mjs && node --check tests/browser/test-pw.cjs && node --check tests/browser/test-dashboard-installments.cjs && node --check tests/browser/test-dashboard-series.cjs && node --check tests/browser/test-monthly-ui.cjs && node --check tests/browser/test-monthly-close-confirm.cjs && node --check tests/browser/test-mobile-pwa.cjs
